description: Cholesky 2..6 on SPD matrices: factor l, solve, inverse

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: cholesky2_l
ops.doc: a.cholesky().unwrap().l() (lower triangular, zeros above the diagonal)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cholesky2_solve
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: cholesky2_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
